# Park City Grand Plaza Kensington

> > A 4-star boutique hotel in Kensington, London, offering direct booking for rooms, dining, and convenient access to Hyde Park, Royal Albert Hall, and major attractions.

Park City Grand Plaza Kensington is located on Lexham Gardens near Gloucester Road Station, providing comfortable accommodations with modern facilities including a halal Malaysian restaurant, fitness center, and business services. The hotel serves couples, families, and business travelers seeking a central London base near Earl's Court, Hyde Park, and cultural landmarks.
